name: starfield_mystic_the_discount_is_for_enchantment_spells_not_for_their_abilities
notes: Printed: 'Enchantment spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.' It reduces the cost of casting a spell, not of activating an ability of an enchantment already in play. Zephyr Charge ({1}{U}: Target creature gains flying until end of turn) is on the battlefield: with one mana its activation is refused; with the second mana it is activated at its full cost, the Bear gains flying, and the pool is empty.
